rows.label: tlk006301_06_msg0001
rows.name:
We Luxurians grew up on tales of
the hero Adel instead of lullabies.

rows.label: tlk006301_06_msg0002
rows.name:
Therefore, we were well
aware of the dangers of
Heaven's Holy Grail.

rows.label: tlk006301_06_msg0003
rows.name:
We feared that Heaven's Holy Grail
would once again bring destruction.

rows.label: tlk006301_06_msg0004
rows.name:
However, I now understand
that we were mistaken.

rows.label: tlk006301_06_msg0005
rows.name:
Heaven's Holy Grail should be by
your side. You must get her
back from Iira.
